name: Biomechanics, Rehabilitation Engineering and Haptics Lab
description: What is biomechanics, different types of biomechanics. Kinetics and kinematics, measurement of biomechanical parameters. Gait analysis, gait disorders. Gait deformities due to injury and disease. Musculoskeletal biomechanics-role of bones, tissues, and organs. Injury biomechanics-sports and accidents. Disease biomechanics-diagnosis and rehabilitation. Introduction to rehabilitation engineering. Rehabilitation of spinal cord injury (SCI) patients, stroke patients, post-trauma recovery. Strength training, muscle activation. What is haptics? Role of haptics in rehabilitation. Visual and vibrotactile feedback-based gait parameter improvement, FES-assisted limb movement and control.
